assembly_summary: Original11-stroke crouched tiger selected jointly with the lying source before keys. Native head and eye marks follow the observed three-quarter-to-frontal turn; native striped body and folded paws hold. Hidden tail is cropped rather than invented.
review_note: 1 independent blind still review round(s). Source framing/pose: not met; original doodle identity: not met. The head has become a very tall, narrow polygon, losing the locked doodle's broad, low head silhouette. This is the dominant visible departure from the original character. No actual normal-speed playback approval, recognition classifier or verified planted-contact gate. No training ran.
